adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `accessTokenParsed` is set via `parseRefreshTokenResponse(accessTokenJson, salesforceTokenSchema)`. The helper `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) explicitly throws when `safeParse` fails (`if (!refreshTokenResponse.success) { throw new Error(...) }`) and only returns afterward, meaning it can only return a result with `success: true`. Therefore the subsequent check `if (!accessTokenParsed.success) { return Promise.reject(...) }` is unreachable/dead code. This is misleading/maintainability debt but does not itself break runtime behavior (the failure path is the thrown exception).
